description: Shared contract fixture for the Verðandi nerve feed (WYRD advancement Phase D6). This file is the machine-readable half of docs/specs/verdandi-nerve-feed.md: the envelope shape and the event->mutation expectations BOTH repos test against. The WYRD side runs it in tests/test_verdandi_seam_hardening.py; the Verðandi side (producer + runner, repo hrabanazviking/Verdandi) adopts it by vendoring this file and asserting (a) its hub emits envelopes of the v1 shape and (b) replaying 'cases' through the real bridge yields exactly the 'expect' state. Expectations were written from the translation table in wyrdforge.bridges.verdandi_bridge (NERVE_FEED_TRANSLATION_TABLE) and verified against the bridge. All timestamps are fixed (2026-09-26) so tense expectations are stable: 'verdhandi' anchors have no end, 'urdhr' anchors end at their start.

optional.schema: integer — schema version; absent means 1. Any other value than a supported version is quarantined by the bridge, never mapped.

required.data: object — the event payload (may be empty)

stamped_by_hub._seq: integer — hub sequence number, strictly increasing
stamped_by_hub._ts: number — epoch seconds when the hub stamped the event

a string schema version is malformed, not version 1
